name: Sentral REIT
overview: Sentral REIT 于2026年1月完成以1.35亿令吉出售 Wisma Sentral Inai，退出该物业；同时于1月委任 Semasa Parking 为 Menara Shell 和 Platinum Sentral 的停车场运营商。年内其余公告主要为季度业绩、股息分派及股东大会相关事项。
overview_en: Sentral REIT completed the disposal of Wisma Sentral Inai for RM135.0 million in January 2026, exiting the property; it also appointed Semasa Parking as the car park operator for Menara Shell and Platinum Sentral in January. The remaining announcements during the year were mainly quarterly results, distributions, and general meeting matters.

segments.name: 商业物业投资
segments.note: 今年完成出售 Wisma Sentral Inai，并委任 Menara Shell 和 Platinum Sentral 的停车场运营商。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of Wisma Sentral Inai and appointed a car park operator for Menara Shell and Platinum Sentral this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 委任 Semasa Parking Sdn Bhd 为 Menara Shell 和 Platinum Sentral 的停车场运营商。
actions.text_en: Appointed Semasa Parking Sdn Bhd as the car park operator for Menara Shell and Platinum Sentral.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以1.35亿令吉现金出售 Wisma Sentral Inai 予 Turiya Properties Sdn Bhd，交易已完成。
actions.text_en: Disposed of Wisma Sentral Inai to Turiya Properties Sdn Bhd for RM135.0 million cash; the disposal was completed.
